name: Mastery points
request: Help me earn mastery points and finish my open mastery tracks. Check my progress and what my account owns, and point me at what to do next.
hints: Mastery goal. Call get_progress with kind mastery for point totals and unfinished tracks, get_account_access for Owned Content, and get_location for the current map and region. Suggest only content the account owns, and say when the best option needs content the Player does not own. Use list_marker_packs and find_marker_categories for packs with mastery insight categories; propose download_pack when one is needed and give the category display path as directions. If Pathing is installed but disabled, propose enable_module through Review and continue configuring it after it applies. If Pathing is missing, propose installing it from the Catalog when an install Action is available; otherwise tell the Player how to install it by hand. Never claim to have turned a category on.
